findings.title: Counted wealth and allies do not become rescue
findings.claim: Within the garden episode, greater counted wealth and a stronger supporting group do not become a rescuing force: the focus's lesser wealth and offspring expose the comparison, while the later loss of faction and self-help removes the boast's supposed support.
findings.mechanism: The context carries permanence and uncertain supposition around the owner's garden, abundance and rivalry in his boast, and a band, faction, and aid that fail after the focus names wealth and offspring as counted measures. The focus carriers for wealth and offspring therefore return the relation from numerical possession to the inability of possession or its human network to produce rescue, under the context's final attribution of authority and outcome to Allah.
findings.reader_payoff: The comparison is newly perceptible as a test of whether possessions and people can function as force, rather than as a merely embarrassing difference in holdings.
findings.containment: This does not deny the reality of wealth, offspring, or human assistance; it bounds the reading to their failure as autonomous rescue in this pericope. The supplied channel nomination is not extended into a general claim about every form of authority or every possession.

epistemic.reason: The channel source is trusted, its focus and context branch records are supplied, and the relation is landed in exact focus/context occurrences and pericope connections.

findings.mechanism: The 18:28 warning joins the eye to worldly adornment, heedlessness, and remembrance, while the focus joins seeing to lesser wealth. Those context carriers meet the focus seeing, lesser, and wealth carriers, changing the comparison from a bare financial report into a test of what the eye is allowed to make significant.
findings.reader_payoff: The word for seeing becomes an active point of moral comparison: the issue is not only what is visible, but what visibility is permitted to decide.
findings.containment: The packet also supports the literal reading that the companion has fewer holdings. This finding does not claim that every act of seeing becomes moral judgment, and the root-identity qualification for the supplied lesser branch remains visible.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record has exact pericope Arabic anchors and a complete attributed trace, but its segmentation and source identity are legacy-unbound and the lexical branch record for the context carriers is unresolved.

findings.title: Agency inside conditions it does not own
findings.claim: The focus relocates agency without erasing choice: human willing is answered by the realized thing being under Allah's willing, so choosing operates within conditions whose efficacy the chooser does not possess.
findings.mechanism: The two human willing forms in 18:29 establish a decision fork beside a command to speak truth, while the focus repeats the will root in the garden formula and names Allah as both the willed source and the source of force. The contact changes the focus from a courteous blessing into a relation between choice, realization, and efficacy.
findings.reader_payoff: The formula becomes an account of where agency sits: it can choose and speak, but it cannot claim ownership of the conditions that make the chosen world effective.
findings.containment: The native reading remains a commanded acknowledgment of Allah's will and power. The attributed finding does not settle a complete theory of freedom and causation; its live alternative is a looser echo about proper speech.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record provides exact 18:29 and 18:39 Arabic anchors and complete source-word traces, but its semantic hierarchy is a legacy-unbound attributed inference.

findings.title: The garden's force is a dependency network
findings.claim: The garden's apparent force is a maintained network of supplied conditions: arrangement and running water produce yield, then inaccessible water and structural collapse remove the capacity without changing the owner's nominal possession.
findings.mechanism: The focus garden and strength carriers meet the context's making and channeling of land and water, followed by water sinking beyond reach, inability to retrieve it, and the garden's collapse. The sequence changes the focus from a general denial of power into a concrete account of how productive capacity is supplied, withdrawn, and mistaken for property.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see what the denied force consists of in the scene: not an invisible abstraction, but the coordinated conditions that make the garden yield and that can be removed.
findings.containment: The dependency model is an attributed contextual inference. The same loss sequence can also be read as external judgment without a systems emphasis; this finding does not replace that narrative reading or claim that all power is reducible to water.

epistemic.reason: The HFT trace is exact to the declared pericope and names every source word and role, but the semantic model is legacy-unbound and its unresolved branches have no independent packet glosses.

findings.claim: The focus dismantles the boast's own equation: greater holdings and a stronger support network do not constitute force in themselves, because the later test removes both the group's aid and the owner's ability to prevail.
findings.mechanism: The context pairs more wealth with a stronger band, the focus answers with lesser wealth and offspring while denying autonomous strength, and 18:43 reports that no faction can help and that the owner cannot help himself. The focus force carrier therefore returns to the economic and social supports that the narrative tests.

findings.containment: This finding does not say that wealth, offspring, or groups have no practical effects. It says the supplied narrative does not let those counted supports become independent force, while the attributed HFT alternative remains that the formula may remain general confirmation.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record supplies exact anchors and source-word roles for the boast, focus, and failed support, but the extension from the ordinary force sense to economic and social leverage is an attributed legacy-unbound inference.

The repeated threshold makes the focus formula the utterance that should have interrupted the earlier inference.
findings.reader_payoff: The formula is newly audible as a corrective act at the moment possession is entered, not merely as a generic blessing added after the fact.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains a reproach for omitted acknowledgment. The attributed evidence leaves open a narrower etiquette reading and does not claim that saying the formula mechanically prevents loss.

findings.title: A root-field turn from force to depletion
findings.claim: Alongside the ordinary strength sense of the focus's force word, the supplied root field permits an exploratory barren-and-empty counter-image: the garden's stripped ground, sunken water, and emptiness faintly turn concentrated capacity toward depletion.
findings.mechanism: The focus q-w-y occurrence carries both the ordinary strength branch and the supplied barren-land branch; the context independently supplies bare ground, slippery footing, inaccessible water, and an empty structure. Those carriers return to the same focus word, changing the denial of autonomous force into a restrained image of force reversing into a depleted landscape.
findings.reader_payoff: The garden's collapse can be felt as the negative image of the force just denied: what appeared concentrated becomes bare, unreachable, and empty.
findings.containment: The ordinary focus sense remains strength and capacity. This is an exploratory root-field resonance, never a translation of the focus word as barren land, and the supplied alternative that the sequence marks external judgment remains open.

epistemic.reason: The HFT record explicitly supplies the focus branch contrast and exact downstream context anchors, but labels the result exploratory and leaves the branch citation legacy-unbound.
